turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: r the first use of your Yonder™ Water Bottle: - Fill it with cold water or another cold drink. - Make sure the Yonder™ Cap is securely attached; the cap is 100% leakproof. - Avoid hot or carbonated beverages, food, and perishables. - Don’t place the bottle in the freezer. - For cleaning, place the bottle in the dishwasher. Put the cap on the top rack and the gasket in the utensils basket. Hand-washing is also fine. - Because the bottle is non-insulated, some condensation can form on the outside.
